audit_run.scope: 16 Core Criteria + AI/LLM Security (17 Total Units)

findings.title: Missing Clickjacking Headers in FastAPI & Flask Responses
findings.remediation: Injected SecurityHeadersMiddleware in FastAPI and @app.after_request hook in Flask enforcing X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN and CSP frame-ancestors.
findings.poc_verification: Verified via scripts/security_pentest.py: TestClient receives X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN (PASS).

findings.title: Missing MIME-Sniffing and Defensive Headers
findings.remediation: Enforced X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and Permissions-Policy.
findings.poc_verification: Verified via scripts/security_pentest.py: TestClient receives X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff (PASS).

findings.title: Unrestricted Outbound Request Target (SSRF Risk)
findings.remediation: Created is_safe_external_url validator with DNS pre-resolution checking against RFC1918, loopback, link-local, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254) networks.

findings.title: AI Prompt Injection & PII Exposure Exposure Vector
findings.remediation: Implemented detect_prompt_injection, sanitize_ai_prompt, redact_sensitive_pii, and validate_tool_execution gates.

findings.title: Browser Extension MV3 Origin & Message Passing Security
findings.remediation: Already enforces sender.id === chrome.runtime.id, script-src 'self', and rejects unwhitelisted PII.
findings.poc_verification: Verified via extensions/shopee-connector/tests/security-audit.cjs (2/2 PASS) and 29/29 baseline tests PASS.
